terms.definition: A straight path extending forever in both directions.
terms.function: Connects points in a perfectly straight, endless row.
terms.whereItIs: The thin stroke across the board.
terms.whyItMatters: Direction and straightness start with the line.

terms.definition: The small mark showing the line continues without end.
terms.function: Signals the path keeps going in that direction.
terms.whereItIs: Each drawn end of the stroke.
terms.whyItMatters: Arrowheads are what make it a line, not a segment.

terms.definition: Two points on the line name it, like line AB.
terms.whereItIs: The label tags on points A and B.
terms.whyItMatters: Naming helps you talk precisely about lines.

terms.definition: The property of not bending, leaning, or curving at all.
terms.function: Every point on a line lies in one straight row.
terms.whereItIs: The unfurled path on the board.
terms.whyItMatters: Straightness is what separates lines from curves.
